company.name: Rainbow
company.shortDescription: Rainbow is a cloud-based treasury solution that helps CFOs and treasurers protect and optimize their liquidity.
company.description: Rainbow develops a software platform focused on automating treasury operations for businesses. The system centralizes access to multiple bank accounts, providing users with a unified view of their cash positions and liquidity across institutions. It supports predictive cash flow forecasting, real-time exposure tracking, and integration with existing investment and foreign exchange workflows. Rainbow also enables direct payments through banking systems while allowing users to tailor workflows to match their internal processes. The platform uses automation and data insights to execute routine treasury tasks, manage financial risks, and optimize return on cash holdings.
